what_this_file_is: The machine-readable public state surface for this project.  It exists so a reviewer can read the project's actual current position from the public repository alone, without access to the private working tree.  It is written to be read as a LIMITS statement first: every field below is a fact about what has been MEASURED, and the ceilings section says what none of it establishes.
how_to_read_this: Read `proof_ladder` before `candidate_ids`, and read `ceilings` last.  A rung that is not claimed is not implied by a lower rung being reached.
generated_note: Regenerated for each development phase.  Values come from the private machine-readable state record, not from prose.

published_evidence_hashes.note: Hashes of artefacts that are themselves published in this repository, so a reader can check that what they have is what was verified.  Hashes of withheld artefacts are excluded by publication policy, and their absence here is policy, not an oversight.

ceilings: Nothing here is a compatibility claim, a performance claim, or a statement that any game, mod or workload works on gfx1030.
A physical numeric pass on a SYNTHETIC operator is not evidence about a real network, a real model, or a real frame.
A host-verified execution backend is not evidence that the backend is correct on hardware.
The published code is the host-side tooling; the device code object and its disassembly are deliberately withheld.
